interactions.body: Governance and succession review. The trust deed has been revised and is with her for review: successor trustees, distribution powers and investment committee authority all change, and she has not yet read it. James has asked by email for a more formal investment role, which matters because the revised deed would give an investment committee real authority. Sophie is exploring an education-focused foundation of S$2–3m, structure undecided. Her instruction is that no assets move until the governance discussion concludes, which freezes work that would otherwise be routine.
interactions.extracted_summary: Revised trust deed awaiting her review; James requesting a formal investment role; Sophie exploring a S$2–3m education foundation; all asset transfers frozen pending the governance decision.

insights.title: Cash falls below her own floor at the first capital call
insights.body: S$11.0m of cash against S$6.95m of dated payments between October and January. Paying them all leaves S$4.05m, which is S$2.95m below the S$7m she asked to keep accessible. The line crosses at the very first call on 12 October and never comes back above it. A further S$6.0m of uncalled commitments is undated and sits on top.
insights.chat_prompt: Build a funding plan for Eleanor's S$6.95m of commitments that holds the S$7m floor.

insights.title: S$17.0m was last valued more than nine months ago
insights.body: Whitfield Ventures at S$3.0m was last valued 31 March 2025, fifteen months ago, and the UK commercial property at S$14.0m on 1 October 2025, nine months ago. Her file treats nine months as stale. Both are at or past it.
insights.chat_prompt: Request updated valuations for Whitfield Ventures and the UK commercial property.

insights.title: Three quarters of the money cannot be sold inside a quarter
insights.body: S$88.6m of S$116.0m — four properties, four private funds and the 12% manufacturing stake. Nothing on file states that as the intended position, so it is an observation rather than a policy being met or missed.
insights.chat_prompt: Draft a liquidity policy for Eleanor covering the share of assets held in illiquid form.

insights.title: Nothing can move until the governance question is settled
insights.body: Her instruction is that no assets transfer until the governance discussion concludes. The revised deed is with her and unread. That single decision gates the trust work, James's role, Sophie's foundation and any restructuring of the illiquid position.
insights.chat_prompt: Summarise what is blocked for Eleanor pending the governance decision, and in what order it unblocks.

insights.title: There is no performance history on file
insights.body: Her securities carry a cost basis and a market value and nothing in between: S$16.4m against S$15.45m, or +6.1% on cost with no holding period recorded. There is no monthly series and no benchmark, so no return can be stated for any period.
